text:
Meet the lightning-fast command-line tool that turns your Markdown into beautiful PDFs in the blink of an eye! Whether you're publishing reports, polishing documentation, or sharing your latest masterpiece, this little powerhouse has you covered. No fuss, no clutter, just pure PDF magic.

Built from the ground up in Go, it ships as a single, self-contained 8 MB binary. That's right: no runtimes to install, no dependency headaches, no tangled toolchains. No Python, no Node, no LaTeX. Just download, drop it in your PATH, and start converting!

And the speed? Absolutely mind-blowing. Need to render 100 pages? Done in just 1.2 seconds! Whether you're working on a quick note or a massive book, your PDFs arrive faster than you can say "export." Every heading, code block, and table comes out crisp and professional. Think of it as your personal document factory.

Best of all, it's free and open source under the MIT license, so you can use it, modify it, and share it however you like. Join the community and start converting today!
